card.title: How To Fix Nintendo Switch OLED With No HDMI Output

source.title: How To Fix Nintendo Switch OLED With No HDMI Output

claims.statement: Switch OLED with no TV output whose HDMI reader (Mechanic) shows pins 8 and 17 as OL usually has a blown choke on the bottom side above the USB-C port.

All four legs of the choke should give diode readings; OL on the port side but readings on the top side means it's bad. Replacement chokes come from other Switches or similar parts near phone display connectors.

procedure: Read the port with an HDMI/USB-C reader; look for OL on pins 8 and 17.
Check continuity/diode on all four choke legs.
Replace the choke; re-read and test docked.
card.caveats: Known-good reader values are in an image on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
